notes: Production-hardening configuration. See YOUTUBE_AUTOMATION_REPLICATION_GUIDE.md section 12 for compliance mode behavior.

youtube_api.compliance_notes: When youtube_api_derived_metrics_authorized is false, analytics functions must store and display raw API metrics only. Derived metrics (like rate, comment_rate, age_normalised_views, trajectory pace, medians, composite scores) are disabled by policy mode until explicit owner permission + audit status confirmation. See scripts/analytics_intelligence.py for feature flags.

synthetic_media_disclosure.note: P0 production requirement: videos with AI-generated images, music, or other synthetic content must disclose this per YouTube policy (https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/14328491). Set contains_ai_generated_content=True for long-form videos with AI-generated visuals or ambient music, short-form videos with synthetic audio effects, etc.
